chunks: [His description, Exalted is His Status] All praise is for Allah who is High by His power and Near by His bounty, the Giver of every reward and distinction, and the Dispeller of every great calamity and hardship.

I praise Him for His continuous mercy and His copious bounties. I believe in Him as He is the First and Manifest. I seek guidance from Him as He is Near and the Guide. I seek His succour as He is Mighty and Subduer. I depend upon Him as He is Sufficer and Supporter.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the opening supplication in Nahj al-Balagha's Al-Gharra?
ai.summary: This opening supplication of Al-Gharra serves as a theological preamble to Imam Ali’s sermon on piety, establishing the metaphysical basis for human conduct through the dialectic of Divine transcendence (Ala) and immanence (Dana). In Shia exegesis, this structure underscores that true taqwa arises from recognizing Allah’s absolute sufficiency (Kafi) and power (Qadir), which empowers the believer to navigate worldly trials with spiritual resilience.
